name: language-bridge
description: Type in your own language; the model reads English, and its English replies are shown translated back.

language.title: Language
language.description: Your language as a BCP-47 code (zh-CN, ja, ko, fr, ...). en turns translation off.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: SiliconFlow (or other OpenAI-compatible) API key. Left empty, SILICONFLOW_API_KEY is read; with neither, a fake translator only tags the text.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model to translate with; a fast non-reasoning call is made (enable_thinking: false).
